scope: Flagship Windows native faithful remaster, not indefinite technical atlas or deferred ports/netplay
estimate_nature: historic subjective anchor; do not recalculate or silently treat as audited
rules: This file freezes a previously communicated subjective estimate, not verification of completed tasks.
Never interpolate from PR count, commits, agent-hours, or tests to completion percentages.
Each new measurable advancement needs stable criterion ID, evidence URL, commit SHA, previous and new status, independent acceptance authority, and date.
Track implementation, tested, independently accepted, and physical/human approval distinctly.
Retractions are recorded as negative deltas rather than erasing prior entries.
Added scope is tracked separately and cannot retroactively lower the frozen baseline.

Future rigorous percentage requires a fixed enumerated acceptance inventory with explicit weights and auditable status for each item; until then report estimated 60% unchanged and actual measured deltas separately.
Release ledger remains sole authority for QA status; this baseline must not award gates.
